clips.title: The story
paras: Fallen in the Fen is a somber journey begun by uncovering a fallen dwarf amidst an excavation site. Delivering the tragic news to his brother, Dorin Songblade in Lakeshire, brings closure to a heartbroken craftsman who had been forging gifts for his departed kin.

A quiet tragedy unfolds at the excavation sites, where the lifeless body of an adventurous dwarf is discovered. After covering the remains with the dwarf's own cloak, an adventurer carries the grim news back to Lakeshire to find his kin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Much of what I was smithin' was for 'im, was plannin' a surprise but it wasn't ready when he came by gettin' things for his journey.
Now that these are finished, I don't have it in me to reforge or sell any of it.
You can have this. It's the least I can do for you, bringing me this grim day.
